title: Cinder rain

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Cinder rain is a weather condition in Ashlands.
Cinders regularly fall from the sky around the player (60 meters range). Cinders set Fire to the Structures they fall on, they also have a 32.1% chance to set fire on the ground for 30 seconds.
The Shield generator can be used to protect from Cinder falling.
The amount of cinder depend on the weather condition.

Cinder rain

Type: Environment | Internal ID: CinderSky

Introduction. Cinder rain is a weather condition in Ashlands.
Cinders regularly fall from the sky around the player (60 meters range). Cinders set Fire to the Structures they fall on, they also have a 32.1% chance to set fire on the ground for 30 seconds.
The Shield generator can be used to protect from Cinder falling.
The amount of cinder depend on the weather condition.
